_about: Example manifest, copied from Episode 2 with the clip links removed. Copy it to E{n}.json for a new episode, paste each finished clip's URL, and update the title, lines, Shorts hooks and cut points. Real manifests contain private clip links, so they are not kept in this public repo.

_font_note: Montserrat ExtraBold (weight 800). A relative path is resolved against this manifest's folder, so keep the .ttf next to E2.json, or give an absolute path. Source: https://github.com/JulietaUla/Montserrat/raw/master/fonts/ttf/Montserrat-ExtraBold.ttf. The script reads the family and weight from the file and refuses to render in anything else.
